description: Rust label sources and the verdict the `schema mutation-labels` gate reaches on each (design §16.2): a leaf label is `LocalizedLabel::native(en, de)` with two non-empty locales or forwards to another label; locale-invariant data, an empty locale, an operation's text line, an unreadable body and an app overriding the leaf label are findings. The token gate and an independent tree-sitter-rust oracle must both reach exactly these verdicts.
